$comment: The image models this repository's asset set is generated by, and where each one's set lives.
Read by BOTH providers.ts and providers.py. It is a JSON file rather than a TypeScript module
with a Python copy beside it because the estate already has one hand-copied registry that has
to be asserted against its source at run time (plan.ts against ui/packages/ui/src/surfaces.ts),
and a second one would be a second thing to keep honest. Two loaders reading one file cannot
drift.
LAYOUT. The reference provider's root is the repository itself: its assets are at assets/ and
its provenance is MANIFEST.json, exactly where they have always been. That is not symmetry for
its own sake being sacrificed — it is a requirement. Around twenty sibling repositories point at
assets/<surface>/favicon-32x32.png and friends (every web app's test/brand-chrome.test.ts,
network-site/src/components/shell.tsx, deploy/compose/docker-compose.estate.yml), and this
repository's own CI globs assets/**/*.png. Moving the reference set to sets/flux/ to make the
three roots look alike would break those consumers and rewrite the `path` of every entry in
MANIFEST.json — the opposite of leaving the reference byte-identical.
So the challengers go under candidates/<id>/, which also states the truth: the reference set is
SHIPPED and the other two are on trial. If a challenger wins it is promoted by moving its tree
to assets/, and the `provider` field on each entry records which model the shipped bytes came
from.
ONE MANIFEST PER SET, not one merged manifest. Regenerating a candidate must never rewrite the
file that holds the reference set's provenance, and a candidate set is expected to be RED for
most of this exercise while the reference stays green. verify.py takes --provider and reads
exactly one manifest, so those two states do not collide.

notes: Cost is NOT flat per image: 3 units up to roughly 1MP, 4.5 measured at 1920x768.
Delivered dimensions floor to a multiple of 16, which is why requestSizeFor rounds up.
Accepts no seed parameter, so `seed` is null on every entry rather than invented.
